description: Check a complete LessonDraft (see get_authoring_guide) against its source set — every quote to the character, no TODO, a sound concept graph — then build the lesson and write it to the learner's library. Returns {ok: true, course_ref, outline, key_classes, findings: [{level, code, message, hint?}], notice} or {ok: false, errors: [{path, message, hint}]}: fix the draft and call again (errors may quote the draft's own keys: keep them from the learner). The outline holds no key; show it to the learner and never show a key. Then start the lesson with start_lesson_session {bundle_ref: course_ref} and relay the notice. An existing lesson is replaced only with overwrite: true, and only a self-study lesson no teacher validated or approved.
name: create_lesson
